# CANDIDATE: VIX1D_RISING_FADE_SHORT

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

An intraday rise in the 1-day VIX signals rising short-term volatility, often preceding a short-term mean-reversion to the downside when price is above VWAP. The strategy captures this by entering short on VIX1D momentum combined with VWAP proximity, targeting the subsequent reversion.

## Mechanism

Entry: Go short when VIX1D (intraday) increases by >0.5 points over the prior 5-minute bar AND price is >0.2% above VWAP. Enter at the close of that 5-minute bar.  
Exit: Initial stop at the most recent swing high (BOS level). TP1 at 1R (risk = entry to stop). Runner trailed using a 15% chandelier trail from the highest-water-mark (HWM) after TP1 fills.  
Regime filters: Only active when daily VIX is between 12-22 AND time is after 11:00 ET. Suspend during major economic releases (FOMC, CPI, NFP, major earnings).
